name: Vercel Ops Monitor
tagline: A daily once-over of a Vercel deployment, with quiet days summed up in one line.
description: Each day it reviews a deployment on Vercel: how spend is tracking against plan credits, whether server errors spiked, how traffic is moving, which routes are missing and whether the latest deploys broke anything. A quiet day costs a single line, so the report stays readable even though it arrives daily.
author: cu30rry_
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
